description: TU Delft provides a Hotterdam physical heat map based on regression and cluster analysis. The source lists imperviousness, surface water, foliage leaf-area index, building envelopes and shade, and describes eight typologies. Values are stated on a one-hectare grid compatible with CBS 100-metre squares. Coverage: 2014. Access: public native metadata describes the identified resource. Licence: 4TU General Terms of Use. Current file access and cost are unknown. Provider-specific reuse conditions have not been read where general terms apply. Caveats: The source calls these social features while listing physical variables; this wording is preserved as a source inconsistency. The extent excludes Rotterdam harbour. Variables, geometry and regression accuracy were not independently inspected. Related resources are separately identified in the native collection. The native Hotterdam source explicitly relates these variables and maps to urban surface-energy modelling and regression. Simulation use concerns built-environment heat exposure.
